exposure: Conception <1 year after liver transplantation vs. conception >1 year after liver transplantation
cohort: 139 pregnancies in 83 women who received liver transplants and became pregnant on immunosuppression regimens between August 1986 and May 2016.
finding: Almost 70% of women who conceive after liver transplantation have live births, which is lower than the general population, and tacrolimus exposure was associated with higher risks of premature delivery and cesarean section compared to cyclosporine.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were higher in women who conceived from 2001 to 2016 compared to those who conceived between 1986 and 2000 (44% vs 32%; P = .025).
